query: UPDATE conversations h SET mcp_servers = ARRAY(SELECT x FROM unnest(h.mcp_servers) WITH ORDINALITY AS a(x, i) WHERE x = ANY(l.mcp_servers) ORDER BY i), connectors = ARRAY(SELECT x FROM unnest(h.connectors) WITH ORDINALITY AS a(x, i) WHERE x = ANY(l.connectors) ORDER BY i) FROM conversations l WHERE h.id = $1 AND l.id = $2
